title: Number Of Nodes With Value One
statement:
The nodes labeled `1` through `n` form a complete binary tree with root 1; the parent of node `v > 1` is `floor(v / 2)`. All nodes initially have value 0. For each query `v`, flip every value in the subtree rooted at `v`. Return the number of nodes whose final value is 1.

## Examples

```text
Input: n = 5, queries = [1, 2, 5]
Output: 3
```

```text
Input: n = 3, queries = [2, 3, 3]
Output: 1
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= n <= 10^5`
- `1 <= queries.length <= 10^5`
- `1 <= queries[i] <= n`
